breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly converts rpm to angular velocity in radians per second using ω = 2π(1200/60) = 40π ≈ 125.664 rad/s, and does NOT use rpm directly as ω. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt ('substitute the listed rpm value directly for ω') was removed and the proper conversion was applied, matching the ground truth approach.
